title: Positivity of the row count
statement: Let $k,n,N,D$ be nonnegative integers satisfying $1\le k\le n$, $0<N$, and $2N\le D$. Define $d=\max(1,\lceil\log_2 n\rceil)$ and $r=(k-1)d+1$. Then $r>0$.
